QuestInfo.name: Master of Alchemy 3
QuestInfo.0: See Grant to learn how to master Alchemy.
QuestInfo.1: Make #b100 #t2003005##k using the recipe from Grant, and show him the results.
QuestInfo.2: Go see Grant again once you reach Alchemy Lv. 8.

0.0: Welcome! I appreciate you taking time from your Alchemy to come here.
0.1: I've called you here to help you fully master Alchemy.
0.2: If you bring me the item I request, I'll give you a small reward. How about it?

yes.0: Yes, good thinking. Just bring me #b100 #t2003005##k. This will raise your Mastery, so hurry back.

no.0: I see. Well, come back when you have the time.

default.0: I don't think you have everything I asked you to get. Come back when you have everything.
